answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a sonnet as the anchor of the cost.
